description.en-US: F-Droid repository for NESTNOTE, a local-first Android notes app.

summary.en-US: A local-first, encrypted note-taking app for Android.

description.en-US:
NESTNOTE is a local-first note-taking app built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Material 3.

Features include creating, editing, pinning, archiving, restoring, searching, sorting, and deleting notes; categories and note colours; light and dark themes; full-screen and quick editors; checklist and bullet tools; writing statistics; JSON backup and restore; and local-data recovery safeguards.

Notes are stored locally with encrypted payloads using AES-GCM and Android Keystore. NESTNOTE has no account or cloud sync. User-exported JSON backups are plaintext and should be stored securely.
